public static interface MutableDeterministic.RegularAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP> extends MutableDeterministic<S,I,T,SP,TP>, MutableAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP>, UniversalDeterministicAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP>
Convenience interface that describes an automaton with finite syntactic and finite semantic state space. This type links a MutableDeterministic with DeterministicFiniteSemantics.
